descriptionHtml:
Bug B02 · P0 · new

Unsaved dictation audio and transcripts stay in the browser's storage after sign-out and after account deletion; a second physician signing in on the same browser gets no prompt, but the data is on the device

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-92570 AC 7 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Was a decision item; reclassified as a bug (PHI exposure). Daniela to confirm what sign-out must clear Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92570/94745): the second physician sees no Recover prompt (that cell passed); sign-out and account deletion both call only clearAllDrafts (SettingsModal.tsx:111, :138), which leaves the recording store. After a successful save the whole text also stays in the draft store until sign-out (TC-10/S29 c). Whether P0 still fits is a question for Quinn.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-23/S25, OAT-02/S16, OAT-03/S24

Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S20 Kept dictation stays with its own patient, resident and physician; every device store holds only the unsaved tail and is wiped on sign-out and account deletion

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 No patient data is stored on the device to support offline use (minimal session cache only, per SOW): only the unsaved tail of a dictation is kept, until the server has it, and it is wiped on sign-ou … (TFA-94745 AC 7; TFA-92570 AC 7)
  • U10a Session expired mid-dictation: the dictation is kept, a sign-in prompt shows, and the dictation is available after signing back in. (UAT EFS state 10; TFA-94745 state 10)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Physician 1 with two Hospital patients (A, B) and two Nursing Home residents (C, D); physician 2 is another @roundai.test account; same browser, launched with a fake microphone (--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream --use-fake-device-for-media-stream --use-file-for-fake-audio-capture=<synthetic wav>)

When (1) Type in A's Encounter box, let it save, the harness ends the session, type a tail, sign in again, open B, then A. (2) The same in Nursing Home with C and D. (3) Start Dictate on A's Encounter box, the harness takes the browser offline mid-dictation, stop Dictate (the recording waits for its transcript), bring the …

Then B never shows A's tail and D never shows C's; A and C show their own tail after signing in; no Hospital tail appears on a Nursing Home chart or the reverse. Physician 2 sees no trace of physician 1. The device stores hold at most the unsaved field text or the pending recording of that field (no name, diagnosis, room or vitals), are emptied once the server h …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From T2 and TFA-94745's 2026-10-05 comment: cp1 (B) mustNotContain A's lines; cp2 (A) mustContain A's line and tail; cp3 (D) mustNotContain C's lines and A's tail; cp4 (C) mustContain C's line and tail and mustNotContain A's tail; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S20

Kept dictation stays with its own patient, resident and physician; every device store holds only the unsaved tail and is wiped on sign-out and account deletion

Tickets: TFA-92570 Mobile: Capacitor wrap for App Store & Google Play (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

18/20 judged cells passed; the 2 failures are known bug B02 (newspec-c/vis-efs-s20-kept-dictation.spec.ts, desktop Chromium, one browser context as the device; typed tails instead of a recording, sessions ended on the server with sessions:_backdateForTests; no model, no microphone). (1) Hospital: physician 1 typed A's line (the server had it, no device draft left), the session ended, A's tail was typed: the sign-in screen showed and the device kept exactly one draft row, key <physician1>:<A>:encounterNotes, text = line + tail; no name, diagnosis, room or typed line in localStorage, sessionStorage or any other IndexedDB database. After signing in again B's box was empty (cp1) and A's box held line + tail (cp2); the server then had the tail and A's draft row was gone. (2) Nursing Home, same with C and D: one draft row for C's visit field; D empty with no C or A text (cp3); C line + tail and no Hospital tail (cp4); draft gone afterwards. (3) A pending recording for A was written straight into 'round-ai-local-audio' / 'pending-recordings' (4 KB synthetic bytes; A's chart then said 'A local encounter recording is waiting for recovery.'). (4) Session ended again, a second tail typed in A, physician 2 signed in on the same browser: their Morning Rounds list showed no trace of physician 1 (cp5), opening A's link gave 'Patient not found.' (cp5b), and physician 1's draft (with the second tail) was removed from the device as soon as physician 2 was signed in - but physician 1's pending recording stayed (record). (5) Physician 2 signed out: sign-in screen (cp6), drafts store empty, recording store still 1 row - FAIL (B02). (6) Physician 1 signed in, one kept draft and one more pending recording were written, Settings › Delete account (native confirm accepted): sign-in screen (cp7), server row counts all 0 and no user or sessions left, drafts store empty, recording store still 2 rows - FAIL (B02). Matches B02's code note: sign-out and deletion call only clearAllDrafts (SettingsModal.tsx:111, :138). Whether a kept tail is allowed at all stays Q5.

Product issue: After a physician signs out, and even after they delete their account, unsent dictation recordings (audio plus the text they were dictated into) stay in the browser's storage on that device; the next person to use the browser does not see them in the app, but the data is still on the device (B02).

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 10 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android; dictation by microphone/speaker (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Needs Dictate with a fake microphone (the pending recording of step 3): dictation by microphone/speaker is set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
